blocks.text:
The 2024 17’ x 8’ Hybrid II Ice Castle is a premium 17’ sleeper with many upgrades including a noticeably higher ceiling, fireplace, large bathroom, clean open layout, black furniture package, and a larger generator.  Before you arrive, your house will be warm, powered, and the 6 holes will be drilled.​


​


If you want a premium 17’ house with multiple upgrades for 4-5 guests, the Hybrid II is the house for you!

Turn key ready

 32" Smart TV

 

 
 CD & DVD Play, Stereo

 

 
 Full Kitchenette (microwave, oven, fridge)

 

 
 Rod holders

 

 
 Ice scoop, pliers, scissors, hooks, splitshots

 

 
 4 Rattle Reels

 Easy parking near the house

 Guide support available if needed
